mutation.before: if (j === value.length && i < text.length - 1) j = pi[j - 1]!;
mutation.description: Drop the `i < text.length - 1` terminal guard in the KMP automaton driver. On a full match at the LAST position of the text, the automaton now resets j to the longest proper border instead of preserving j === value.length, so longestPrefixSuffix under-reports the prefix-suffix length when the text ends with the complete secret. redactBoundaryPrefix then fails to redact it and the whole secret leaks. This reproduces a real documented past regression (the pre-fix terminal reset described in the source comment).
